threadDescriptions.league-rosters: Maintain eligible team lineups and substitutions for an online chess league
threadDescriptions.broadcast-show: Produce the league's public commentary stream
threadDescriptions.appeals-desk: Document and resolve formal match-result appeals
threadDescriptions.sponsor-report: Report league participation and audience totals to its sponsor
threadDescriptions.volunteer-shifts: Staff the league's moderation and helpdesk shifts

items.text: Online league roster deadline Monday noon. Heron submitted five starters and two reserves; verify each account against the eligibility sheet.
Commentary stream rundown: opening graphic, captain interviews, featured game, results wrap. Keep player webcams off unless consent is recorded.
Aquarium filter rattles after cleaning. Check the impeller seating before replacing the pump; fish are feeding normally.
Volunteer rota: Sal covers chat moderation 18–20, Eren takes helpdesk 19–21. Need relief for the final half-hour.
Heron appeal A9: captain contests a disconnect loss. Save game log and both statements; no ruling until the reconnect times are checked.
Sponsor wants total registered players and average live viewers in the season report. Do not combine registrations with people who actually played.
Roster correction from Heron: reserve Jun replaces starter Niko this week. Eligibility checked; preserve the original submission in the audit folder.
Broadcast rehearsal: guest audio echoes when the browser monitor is on. Mute the local preview and retest captain interviews.
A9 log shows reconnect within the published grace period. Draft the appeal ruling to restore the unfinished game, pending the second arbiter's check.
Heron / reserve / check the water
items.rationale: Mixed incomplete cues do not establish a coherent task.

items.text: Aquarium test strip looks high for nitrate; use the liquid test before deciding on a water change. Write both readings in the tank log.
Sal can only moderate until 19 now. Move Eren from helpdesk to chat at 19 and recruit someone to cover the helpdesk gap.

For the sponsor report, configure the league stream to export concurrent-viewer samples every minute. Add that export to the broadcast producer's end-of-show checklist and use the samples to calculate the promised average.
items.rationale: Sets broadcast operation and sponsor-analysis workflow.

items.text: Heron's substitute Jun is visible on the locked league roster. Captains should use that list when checking opponents tonight.
Appeal A9 approved by both arbiters. Notify the captains of the restored game; retain the original disconnect result alongside the ruling.
Liquid aquarium test confirmed elevated nitrate. Changed a quarter of the water, matched temperature, and logged the reading afterward.
Sponsor report draft: 42 registered, 35 played; average live audience 61. The exported stream samples support the audience figure.
New volunteer confirmed for helpdesk 19–21. Send the escalation contacts and practice one dummy support request before league night.
Clip this bit for later. The second number was wrong.
Commentary replay checked: echo gone, final results slate readable. Trim the silent opening minute before posting the archived show.
